data.title: US Supreme Court allows Trump ballroom project to proceed
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The US Supreme Court on Monday allowed President Donald Trump to continue construction of his White House ballroom, granting him a major victory against opponents of the project.

data.title: Trump says AI data center opponents want to be 'backwards and poor'
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump on Monday attacked opponents of artificial intelligence data centers, saying they would end up "backwards and poor" and were helping rival China.

data.title: Galliano pulls Met Gala exhibit after antisemitism backlash
data.description: NEW YORK - Top fashion designer John Galliano announced Monday he was cancelling an exhibition of his work that was to kick off New York's Met Gala next spring, following criticism from donors and political leaders over his past antisemitic remarks.

data.title: Trump says US reviewing position on Falkland Islands
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump said Monday that the United States is reviewing its position on the Falkland Islands, after reports that Washington threatened to oppose Britain's sovereignty if it does not increase defense spending.

data.title: Kyiv orders heightened security amid intense Russian drone strikes
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Ukraine on Monday announced stricter security protocols for Kyiv public transport, schools and even parliament amid a major surge in Russian drone attacks it says are aimed at "paralysing" the Ukrainian capital.

data.title: Jury begins deliberations in Tupac Shakur murder trial
data.description: LAS VEGAS - A jury began deliberations on Monday in the trial of a former Los Angeles gang leader accused of involvement in the sensational murder three decades ago of chart-topping rapper Tupac Shakur.

data.title: Tribunal says India cannot withdraw from water treaty with Pakistan
data.description: THE HAGUE - An international tribunal ordered India on Monday to "observe its obligations" under a treaty with Pakistan on the sharing of the Indus and other rivers, which the New Delhi government sought to suspend.

data.title: Japan's oldest person, 115-year-old woman from Nara Prefecture, dies
data.description: KYODO — Japan's oldest person, Shigeko Kagawa, a 115-year-old resident of Nara Prefecture, western Japan, died late last week, the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare reported on Monday.

data.title: Swollen rivers, washed-out roads hamper Nepal rescue effort
data.description: BIDUR (NEPAL) - Nepali rescue teams battled difficult terrain, an unpredictable river and treacherous marshland on Monday, the sixth day in their search for survivors and victims of devastating floods.

data.title: Cambodia says no online scam compounds remain, experts sceptical
data.description: ​The Cambodian government has claimed a milestone ‌in its fight against the scam industry accused of stealing billions of dollars from victims around the world, with officials saying they have eradicated all scam compounds in the country.

data.title: Passengers stranded overnight by Kenya airport strike
data.description: NAIROBI — Hundreds of passengers were stranded at Kenya's main international airport overnight as the latest strike by workers entered a second day on Monday.

data.title: Iran, US trade fire in first exchange for a month
data.description: TEHRAN — Iran attacked United States military targets in the Middle East on Monday in retaliation for American strikes on an island in the Strait of Hormuz, the first exchange of fire for a month in a war that has engulfed the region.

data.title: Rescuers hunt for missing after deadly Northern Cyprus ferry accident
data.description: ISTANBUL - Rescuers were on Monday still hunting for survivors a day after a ferry capsized off Northern Cyprus, leaving eight dead and more than a dozen missing, authorities said.

data.title: South Korea court gives Unification Church leader 2 years prison
data.description: SEOUL - A South Korean court sentenced the leader of the secretive and powerful Unification Church on Monday to two years in prison on charges of bribing officials, including the then president's wife.

data.title: Nepal recovers bodies but presses on for trapped tunnel workers
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - Nepali rescuers raced on Monday in a bid to free dozens of hydropower workers believed trapped in tunnels after devastating floods as search efforts entered a sixth day, officials said.

data.title: Another Ukrainian town lies in ruins as Russians creep closer
data.description: DRUZHKIVKA, Ukraine - Burned ⁠out cars. Rubble from flattened ​buildings strewn along deserted streets. The rumble of artillery guns followed by the high-pitched whine of ​an attack drone.

data.title: Grand Canyon flash flood leaves one dead, around 15 missing
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - At least one person was killed and around 15 others are missing after a flash flood at the Grand Canyon, one of the most popular tourist sites in the United States, the National Park Service said in a statement Sunday.

data.title: Hong Kong police investigate viral video of dog trapped in running washing machine
data.description: Hong Kong police are investigating social media videos that appear to show a dog trapped inside a running washing machine.

data.title: At least five leaders to skip annual Pacific Islands summit
data.description: KOROR, Paualu - At least five leaders will skip the Pacific Island region's annual summit, officials said Monday, hours before the opening of talks overshadowed by Taiwan-China tensions.

data.title: Latest developments in the US-Iran war
data.description: PARIS - The Middle East war has flared again after a month of relative quiet, with American strikes on an Iran island leading to retaliation from Tehran on Monday.

data.title: Chinese guitar capital's stairway to export heaven
data.description: ZHENG'AN, China - It does not take long to guess the main industry of the Chinese town of Zheng'an. A giant guitar sculpture dominates the central square, guitar murals adorn walls and pavements and even the rubbish bins are shaped like guitars.

data.title: Nepal buries dead as rescuers seek thousands missing
data.description: BIDUR, Nepal - Nepal was burying on Monday some of the hundreds of bodies retrieved after a deadly, tsunami-like flood crashed through the Himalayan region, sweeping away villages and leaving thousands still missing.

data.title: Trump calls for 'punishment' of NBC reporter
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump on Sunday threatened a prominent NBC broadcast journalist with possible punishment by US media regulators as the Republican expressed disappointment with coverage of his candidate endorsements ahead of November's midterm elections.

data.title: US strikes Iran for first time in a month, Tehran retaliates
data.description: WASHINGTON - The United States said on Sunday it had attacked Iranian rocket launchers on a small island in the Strait of Hormuz, its first strikes on Iran in a month, prompting Tehran to retaliate.

data.title: Google Maps renames Lake Ontario 'Lake America' in US -- but not Canada
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Google redesignated Lake Ontario as "Lake America" on maps seen by US users Sunday after President Donald Trump announced he was renaming the body of water, with a Canadian official slamming the cross-border tensions as "absolutely backwards."

data.title: At least seven die in ferry capsize off Northern Cyprus; 23 missing
data.description: GIRNE KEPUVEIA (CYPRUS) - A passenger ferry capsized and sank off Northern Cyprus on Sunday, killing at least seven people and leaving 23 missing, officials said, as a rescue operation was under way.

data.title: Niger mutiny suppressed, but questions remain over junta's cohesion
data.description: ABIDJAN - Niger's military regime and its Russian paramilitary partners put down a mutiny by soldiers after a long and confusing day of fighting around the capital Niamey.

data.title: Zambia's opposition leader charged with treason
data.description: LUSAKA - Zambia's detained opposition leader Brian Mundubile has been charged with treason, his lawyer said on Sunday, deepening concerns over the government's treatment of political dissent.
